verses.text: For di beginning, di Word dey, and di Word dey with God, and di Word na God.
Na im dey with God for di beginning.
Through am dem make all things. Without am, nothing dey wey dem make.
Life dey inside am, and di life na di light of men.
Di light dey shine for darkness, and di darkness no overcome am.
One man come, wey God send, wey im name na John.
E come as witness, to testify about di light, so that all go believe through am.
E no be di light, but dem send am to testify about di light.
Di true light wey dey give light to everybody dey come enter di world.
E dey for di world, and dem make di world through am, but di world no recognize am.
E come to im own, but im own people no receive am.
But as many as receive am, to dem e give di right to become God pikin dem, to di people wey believe im name:
wey dem born, no be by blood, or by di will of flesh, or by di will of man, but by God.
Di Word become flesh, and live among us. We see im glory, glory like di only Pikin of Papa God, full of grace and truth.
John testify about am. E shout, dey talk say, “Na am I talk about, ‘Di one wey dey come after me don pass me, because e dey before me.’”
From im fullness we all receive grace upon grace.
Because dem give di law through Moses. Grace and truth come through Jesus Christ.
Nobody don ever see God. Di only Pikin, wey dey di bosom of Papa God, don make am known.
Na this be John testimony, when di Jews send priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask am, “Who you be?”
E declare, and e no deny, but e declare, “I no be di Christ.”
Dem ask am, “Den wetin? You na Elijah?” E talk say, “I no be.” “You na di prophet?” E answer, “No.”
Dem talk to am say, “Who you be? Give us answer to carry go to di people wey send us. Wetin you talk about yourself?”
E talk say, “I be di voice of one wey dey shout for di wilderness, ‘Make una straighten di way for Lord,’ as Isaiah di prophet talk.”
Di people wey dem send na from di Pharisees.
Dem ask am, “Den why you dey baptize if you no be di Christ, or Elijah, or di prophet?”
John answer dem, “I dey baptize with water, but one dey stand among una wey una no know.
Na im dey come after me, wey dem prefer pass me, wey I no worthy to loose im sandal strap.”
These things happen for Bethany for di other side of Jordan, wia John dey baptize.
Di next day, e see Jesus dey come to am, talk say, “Look, di Lamb of God, wey dey take away di sin of di world!
Na am I talk about, ‘After me one man dey come wey dem prefer pass me, because e dey before me.’
I no know am, but na for this reason I come dey baptize with water: so that dem go reveal am to Israel.”
John testify, talk say, “I don see di Spirit dey come down like dove from heaven, and e stay on am.
I no recognize am, but di one wey send me to baptize with water talk to me, ‘Anybody wey you go see di Spirit come down and stay on, na im be di one wey dey baptize with Holy Spirit.’
I don see, and I don testify say this na God Pikin.”
Again, di next day, John dey stand with two of im disciples,
and e look Jesus as e dey waka, talk say, “Look, di Lamb of God!”
Di two disciples hear am talk, and dem follow Jesus.
Jesus turn, see dem dey follow, talk to dem say, “Wetin una dey look for?” Dem talk to am say, “Rabbi, wey mean Teacher, wia you dey stay?”
E talk to dem say, “Come, make una see.” Dem come see wia e dey stay, and dem stay with am that day. E be about di tenth hour.
One of di two wey hear John and follow Jesus na Andrew, Simon Peter brother.
E first find im own brother, Simon, talk to am say, “We don find di Messiah!” wey mean Christ.
E bring am to Jesus. Jesus look am, talk say, “You na Simon, Jonah son. Dem go call you Cephas,” wey mean Peter.
Di next day, e decide to go out go Galilee, and e find Philip. Jesus talk to am say, “Follow me.”
Now Philip na from Bethsaida, di town of Andrew and Peter.
Philip find Nathanael, talk to am say, “We don find di one wey Moses write about for di law, and di prophets too: Jesus of Nazareth, Joseph son.”
Nathanael talk to am say, “Anything good fit come from Nazareth?” Philip talk to am say, “Come see.”
Jesus see Nathanael dey come to am, talk about am say, “Look, real Israelite, wey no get deceit!”
Nathanael talk to am say, “How you take know me?” Jesus answer am, “Before Philip call you, when you dey under di fig tree, I see you.”
Nathanael answer am, “Rabbi, you na God Pikin! You na King of Israel!”
Jesus answer am, “Because I tell you, ‘I see you under di fig tree,’ you believe? You go see greater things pass these!”
E talk to am say, “Na true I dey tell una all, from now una go see heaven open, and di angels of God dey go up and dey come down on di Son of Man.”
For di third day, wedding dey for Cana of Galilee. Jesus mama dey there.
Dem invite Jesus too, with im disciples, to di wedding.
When di wine finish, Jesus mama talk to am say, “Dem no get wine again.”
Jesus talk to am say, “Woman, wetin that concern you and me? My hour never reach.”
Im mama talk to di servants say, “Anything wey e talk to una, do am.”
Now six stone water pots dey there, as di Jews way of purification, each one dey carry two or three metretes.
Jesus talk to dem say, “Fill di water pots with water.” So dem fill dem reach di top.
E talk to dem say, “Now draw some out, carry go give di ruler of di feast.” So dem carry am.
When di ruler of di feast taste di water wey don turn wine, and e no know wia e come from—but di servants wey draw di water know—di ruler of di feast call di groom,
talk to am say, “Everybody dey serve di good wine first, and when di guests don drink well, den di one wey worse. But you don keep di good wine until now!”
Na this be di beginning of im signs wey Jesus do for Cana of Galilee, and e reveal im glory; and im disciples believe am.
After this, e go down Capernaum, e, and im mama, and im brothers, and im disciples; and dem no stay there many days.
Di Passover of di Jews don near, and Jesus go up to Jerusalem.
E find for di temple di people wey dey sell oxen, sheep, and doves, and di money changers dey sit.
E make whip from ropes, throw all out of di temple, both di sheep and di oxen; and e pour out di money changers money, turn over dem tables.
To di people wey dey sell di doves, e talk say, “Carry these things go out from here! No turn my Papa God house to marketplace!”
Im disciples remember say dem write, “Zeal for your house go consume me.”
Di Jews answer am, “Wetin sign you dey show us, as you dey do these things?”
Jesus answer dem, “Destroy this temple, and for three days I go raise am up.”
Di Jews talk say, “Dem take 46 years build this temple! You go raise am up for three days?”
But e dey talk about di temple of im body.
So when dem raise am from di dead, im disciples remember say e talk this, and dem believe di Scripture, and di word wey Jesus talk.
Now when e dey Jerusalem for di Passover, during di feast, plenty people believe im name, as dem see im signs wey e do.
But Jesus no trust imself to dem, because e know everybody,
and because e no need make anybody testify about man; because e imself know wetin dey inside man.
Now one man dey from di Pharisees wey im name na Nicodemus, ruler of di Jews.
Na im come to am for night, talk to am say, “Rabbi, we know say you na teacher wey come from God, because nobody fit do these signs wey you dey do, unless God dey with am.”
Jesus answer am, “Na true I dey tell you, unless person born again, e no fit see God Kingdom.”
Nicodemus talk to am say, “How man fit born when e don old? E fit enter im mama womb second time, and born?”
Jesus answer, “Na true I dey tell you, unless person born by water and spirit, e no fit enter God Kingdom.
Wetin dem born by flesh na flesh. Wetin dem born by di Spirit na spirit.
No marvel say I talk to you, ‘Una must born again.’
Di wind dey blow wia e want, and you dey hear im sound, but you no know wia e come from and wia e dey go. Na so e be for everybody wey dem born by di Spirit.”
Nicodemus answer am, “How these things fit be?”
Jesus answer am, “You na di teacher of Israel, and you no understand these things?
Na true I dey tell you, we dey talk wetin we know, and dey testify about wetin we don see, and una no dey receive our witness.
If I tell una earthly things and una no believe, how una go believe if I tell una heavenly things?
Nobody don go up to heaven, except di one wey come down from heaven, di Son of Man, wey dey heaven.
As Moses lift up di snake for di wilderness, na so dem must lift up di Son of Man,
so that anybody wey believe am no go perish, but get life wey no dey end.
Because God love di world so tay e give im only Pikin, so that anybody wey believe am no go perish, but get life wey no dey end.
Because God no send im Pikin enter di world to judge di world, but so that di world go dey saved through am.
Di one wey believe am, dem no dey judge am. Di one wey no believe don dey judged already, because e no believe di name of God only Pikin.
Na this be di judgment, say di light don come enter di world, and men love darkness pass light; because dem works evil.
Because everybody wey dey do evil hate di light, and e no dey come to di light, so that dem no go expose im works.
But di one wey dey do di truth dey come to di light, so that dem go reveal im works, say dem do dem for God.”
After these things, Jesus come with im disciples enter di land of Judea. E stay there with dem and baptize.
John dey baptize for Aenon near Salim too, because plenty water dey there. Dem dey come, dey baptize.
Because dem never throw John inside prison.
So argument rise between John disciples and some Jews about purification.
Dem come to John, talk to am say, “Rabbi, di one wey dey with you for di other side of Jordan, wey you testify about, look, na im dey baptize, and everybody dey go to am.”
John answer, “Man no fit receive anything, unless dem give am from heaven.
Una yourselves dey testify say I talk, ‘I no be di Christ,’ but, ‘Dem send me before am.’
Di one wey get di bride na di groom; but di friend of di groom, wey stand and hear am, dey rejoice well well because of di groom voice. So my joy don full.
E must increase, but I must decrease.
Di one wey come from above dey above all. Di one wey come from di earth belong to di earth, and dey talk about di earth. Di one wey come from heaven dey above all.
Wetin e don see and hear, na im e dey testify; and nobody dey receive im witness.
Di one wey receive im witness don put im seal say God na true.
Because di one wey God send dey talk God words; because God no dey give di Spirit by measure.
Papa God love di Pikin, and don put all things inside im hand.
Di one wey believe di Pikin get life wey no dey end, but di one wey no obey di Pikin no go see life, but God wrath dey stay on am.”
So when Lord know say di Pharisees don hear say Jesus dey make and baptize more disciples pass John
—although Jesus imself no dey baptize, but im disciples—
e leave Judea, go back to Galilee again.
E need to pass through Samaria.
So e reach one town for Samaria wey dem call Sychar, near di piece of ground wey Jacob give im son Joseph.
Jacob well dey there. So Jesus, as e don tire from di journey, sit down by di well. E be about di sixth hour.
One woman of Samaria come to draw water. Jesus talk to am say, “Give me water to drink.”
Because im disciples don go inside di town to buy food.
Di Samaritan woman talk to am say, “How e be say you, as Jew, dey ask me for water to drink, me wey be Samaritan woman?” Because Jews no dey mix with Samaritans.
Jesus answer am, “If you know di gift of God, and who be di one wey dey tell you, ‘Give me water to drink,’ you go don ask am, and e go don give you living water.”
Di woman talk to am say, “Oga, you no get wetin to draw with, and di well deep. From where you take get that living water?
You greater pass our papa Jacob, wey give us di well, and drink from am imself, and im sons, and im cattle?”
Jesus answer am, “Everybody wey drink this water go thirst again,
but anybody wey drink di water wey I go give am no go ever thirst again; but di water wey I go give am go become inside am well of water wey dey spring up to life wey no dey end.”
Di woman talk to am say, “Oga, give me this water, so that I no go thirst, and I no go come all di way here to draw.”
Jesus talk to am say, “Go, call your husband, come here.”
Di woman answer, “I no get husband.” Jesus talk to am say, “You talk well, ‘I no get husband,’
because you don get five husbands; and di one wey you get now no be your husband. This one you talk na true.”
Di woman talk to am say, “Oga, I see say you na prophet.
Our papa dem worship for this mountain, and una Jews dey talk say Jerusalem na di place wia person suppose worship.”
Jesus talk to am say, “Woman, believe me, di hour dey come, wey una no go worship Papa God for this mountain, or for Jerusalem.
Una dey worship wetin una no know. We dey worship wetin we know; because salvation na from di Jews.
But di hour dey come, and e don reach, wey di true worshipers go worship Papa God with spirit and truth, because Papa God dey look for people like that to be im worshipers.
God na spirit, and di people wey worship am must worship with spirit and truth.”
Di woman talk to am say, “I know say Messiah dey come, di one wey dem dey call Christ. When e come, e go tell us all things.”
Jesus talk to am say, “Na me, di one wey dey talk to you.”
Na this time im disciples come. Dem marvel say e dey talk with woman; but nobody talk, “Wetin you dey look for?” or, “Why you dey talk with am?”
So di woman leave im water pot, go inside di town, talk to di people say,
“Come, see one man wey tell me everything wey I do. E fit be say na di Christ?”
Dem go out of di town, dey come to am.
For di meantime, di disciples beg am, dey talk say, “Rabbi, chop.”
But e talk to dem say, “I get food to chop wey una no know about.”
So di disciples talk to each other say, “Anybody bring am something to chop?”
Jesus talk to dem say, “My food na to do di will of di one wey send me, and to finish im work.
Una no dey talk say, ‘Four months still remain before harvest’? Look, I dey tell una, lift up una eyes, look di farms, say dem don white for harvest.
Di one wey dey harvest dey receive wages, and dey gather fruit for life wey no dey end; so that both di one wey plant and di one wey harvest go rejoice together.
Because for this di saying true, ‘One dey plant, and another dey harvest.’
I send una to harvest wetin una no labor for. Others don labor, and una don enter dem labor.”
From that town plenty of di Samaritans believe am because of di word of di woman, wey testify, “E tell me everything wey I do.”
So when di Samaritans come to am, dem beg am to stay with dem. E stay there two days.
Plenty more believe because of im word.
Dem talk to di woman, “Now we believe, no be because of wetin you talk, because we don hear for ourselves, and we know say this na truly di Christ, di Savior of di world.”
After di two days e leave there go Galilee.
Because Jesus imself testify say prophet no get honor for im own country.
So when e reach Galilee, di Galileans receive am, as dem don see all di things wey e do for Jerusalem for di feast, because dem go di feast too.
Jesus come again to Cana of Galilee, wia e turn di water to wine. One nobleman dey wey im son dey sick for Capernaum.
When e hear say Jesus don come from Judea go Galilee, e go meet am, beg am make e come down heal im son, because e near death.
Jesus talk to am say, “Unless una see signs and wonders, una no go believe at all.”
Di nobleman talk to am say, “Oga, come down before my pikin die.”
Jesus talk to am say, “Go your way. Your son dey alive.” Di man believe di word wey Jesus talk to am, and e go im way.
As e dey go down, im servants meet am, tell am say, “Your pikin dey alive!”
So e ask dem di hour wey e begin better. Dem talk to am say, “Yesterday for di seventh hour, di fever leave am.”
So di papa know say na that hour Jesus talk to am say, “Your son dey alive.” E believe, and im whole house too.
Na this be di second sign again wey Jesus do, as e don come from Judea go Galilee.
After these things, feast of di Jews dey, and Jesus go up to Jerusalem.
Now for Jerusalem by di sheep gate, pool dey, wey dem call for Hebrew “Bethesda,” wey get five porches.
Plenty sick people lie there, blind, lame, or paralyzed, dey wait for di water to move;
because angel of di Lord dey go down for certain times enter di pool, stir up di water. Anybody wey first step in after di water stir, e go well from any disease wey e get.
One man dey there, wey don sick for 38 years.
When Jesus see am dey lie there, and know say e don sick for long time, e ask am, “You want make you well?”
Di sick man answer am, “Oga, I no get anybody to put me inside di pool when di water stir, but as I dey come, another person don step down before me.”
Jesus talk to am say, “Get up, carry your mat, waka.”
At once, di man well, and carry im mat waka. Now na Sabbath that day.
So di Jews talk to di one wey well, “Na Sabbath. Law no allow you to carry di mat.”
E answer dem, “Di one wey make me well, na im talk to me, ‘Carry your mat, waka.’”
Den dem ask am, “Who be di man wey talk to you, ‘Carry your mat, waka’?”
But di one wey heal no know who e be, because Jesus don leave, as crowd dey di place.
After, Jesus find am for di temple, talk to am say, “Look, you don well. No sin again, so that nothing worse go happen to you.”
Di man go, tell di Jews say na Jesus make am well.
For this reason di Jews dey persecute Jesus, and dey look for way to kill am, because e dey do these things for Sabbath.
But Jesus answer dem, “My Papa God still dey work, so I dey work too.”
For this reason di Jews dey look more for way to kill am, because e no only break Sabbath, but e call God im own Papa too, make imself equal with God.
So Jesus answer dem, “Na true I dey tell una, di Pikin no fit do anything by imself, except wetin e see Papa God dey do. Because anything wey Papa God dey do, di Pikin dey do am too.
Because Papa God love di Pikin, and e dey show am all things wey e imself dey do. E go show am greater works pass these, so that una go marvel.
Because as Papa God dey raise di dead and dey give dem life, na so di Pikin dey give life to whoever e want.
Because Papa God no dey judge anybody, but e don give all judgment to di Pikin,
so that all go honor di Pikin, just as dem dey honor Papa God. Di one wey no honor di Pikin no honor Papa God wey send am.
Na true I dey tell una, di one wey hear my word, and believe di one wey send me, get life wey no dey end, and e no go enter judgment, but e don pass from death enter life.
Na true I dey tell una, di hour dey come, and e don reach, wey di dead go hear God Pikin voice; and di people wey hear go live.
Because as Papa God get life inside imself, na so e give di Pikin to get life inside imself too.
E give am authority to do judgment too, because e be son of man.
No marvel for this, because di hour dey come, wey all di people wey dey inside tombs go hear im voice,
and go come out; di people wey do good, go di resurrection of life; and di people wey do evil, go di resurrection of judgment.
I no fit do anything by myself. As I hear, so I dey judge, and my judgment righteous; because I no dey look for my own will, but di will of my Papa God wey send me.
If I testify about myself, my witness no valid.
Another person dey testify about me. I know say di testimony wey e dey testify about me na true.
Una don send to John, and e don testify to di truth.
But di testimony wey I receive no come from man. But I dey talk these things so that una go dey saved.
E be lamp wey dey burn and dey shine, and una dey willing to rejoice for small time for im light.
But di testimony wey I get greater pass John own, because di works wey Papa God give me to finish, di very works wey I dey do, dey testify about me, say Papa God don send me.
Papa God imself, wey send me, don testify about me. Una never hear im voice any time, or see im form.
Una no get im word dey live inside una; because una no believe di one wey e send.
Una dey search di Scriptures, because una think say inside dem una get life wey no dey end; and na dem dey testify about me.
Yet una no go come to me, so that una go get life.
I no dey receive glory from men.
But I know una, say una no get God love inside una.
I don come for my Papa God name, and una no receive me. If another person come for im own name, una go receive am.
How una go fit believe, una wey dey receive glory from each other, and una no dey look for di glory wey come from di only God?
No think say I go accuse una to Papa God. One dey wey dey accuse una, na Moses, wey una don put una hope on.
Because if una believe Moses, una go believe me; because e write about me.
But if una no believe im writings, how una go believe my words?”
